test_cases.title: Sort the visible product listing by name from A to Z
preconditions: The user has established the authenticated state through the visible login flow and the product listing is displayed.
test_data_requirements: Use the products currently visible in the listing; do not assume a fixed catalog or fixed initial order.
Retain the visible product names before sorting so the post-sort collection can be checked for the same visible products.

steps.action: Read and retain the names of all products currently visible in the product listing as runtime collection productsBeforeSort.
steps.expected_result: productsBeforeSort contains the visible product names in their current displayed order.

steps.action: Choose the visible product-list sorting option for name A to Z.
steps.expected_result: The product listing updates to the selected name-sorting criterion.

steps.action: Read and retain the names of all products visible after sorting as runtime collection productsAfterSort.
steps.expected_result: productsAfterSort contains the visible product names after the sorting operation.

steps.action: Compare productsAfterSort with productsBeforeSort and check the name order.
steps.expected_result: The visible product names are in ascending alphabetical order, and the visible product collection remains present.

expected_results: Selecting name A to Z produces a visible product listing whose names are in ascending alphabetical order.
The sorting operation does not remove or add a visible product in the observed collection.

test_cases.title: Sort the visible product listing by price from low to high
preconditions: The user has established the authenticated state through the visible login flow and the product listing is displayed.
test_data_requirements: Use the prices currently displayed for the visible products; do not assume fixed catalog values or currency formatting.
Retain the visible product names and prices before sorting, and compare displayed prices by their numeric values after ignoring presentation-only currency formatting.

steps.action: Read and retain all visible product names and displayed prices as runtime collection productsBeforeSort.
steps.expected_result: productsBeforeSort contains each visible product with its displayed price captured for runtime comparison.

steps.action: Choose the visible product-list sorting option for price low to high.
steps.expected_result: The product listing updates to the selected price-sorting criterion.

steps.action: Read and retain all visible product names and displayed prices after sorting as runtime collection productsAfterSort.
steps.expected_result: productsAfterSort contains the visible product prices after the sorting operation.

steps.action: Compare productsAfterSort with productsBeforeSort and check the numeric price order.
steps.expected_result: The visible product prices are in ascending numeric order, and the visible product collection remains present.

expected_results: Selecting price low to high produces a visible product listing whose displayed prices are in ascending numeric order.
The product-to-price associations remain visible and the sorting operation does not remove or add a visible product.
